svg.title: San Francisco material atlas
svg.desc: 4 by 8 GPU texture sheet. Each named swatch occupies 256 square pixels; model colors tint its relief.

svg.title: Grass
svg.desc: Park lawns and planted courtyards; mottled ground cover with fine blades. Neutral relief is tinted by the model color.

svg.title: Dirt
svg.desc: Walking paths, dry scrub and exposed soil; pebbles and fine grain. Neutral relief is tinted by the model color.

svg.title: Cobblestone
svg.desc: Plazas and building footprints; irregular paving stones and joints. Neutral relief is tinted by the model color.

svg.title: Asphalt
svg.desc: Street surfaces; aggregate flecks and hairline wear. Neutral relief is tinted by the model color.

svg.title: Sidewalk
svg.desc: Pavements and curbs; concrete slabs and expansion joints. Neutral relief is tinted by the model color.

svg.title: Sand
svg.desc: Ocean Beach and sandy ground; light grains and soft surface variation. Neutral relief is tinted by the model color.

svg.title: Brick
svg.desc: Masonry walls and architectural details; staggered courses with mortar. Neutral relief is tinted by the model color.

svg.title: Clapboard
svg.desc: Painted townhome siding; horizontal timber boards. Neutral relief is tinted by the model color.

svg.title: Roof
svg.desc: Dark roofing and flat roof surfaces; weathered roofing grain. Neutral relief is tinted by the model color.

svg.title: Stone
svg.desc: Civic masonry, foundations and monuments; cut stone blocks. Neutral relief is tinted by the model color.

svg.title: Shingles
svg.desc: Pitched residential roofs; overlapping shingle courses. Neutral relief is tinted by the model color.

svg.title: Stucco
svg.desc: Plastered façades; fine, uneven mineral grain. Neutral relief is tinted by the model color.

svg.title: Timber
svg.desc: Wooden stairs, balconies and fixtures; long timber grain. Neutral relief is tinted by the model color.

svg.title: Clay roof tiles
svg.desc: Tiled roofs; curved tile courses with recessed seams. Neutral relief is tinted by the model color.

svg.title: Glass
svg.desc: Windows and glazed towers; subtle reflections and pane detail. Neutral relief is tinted by the model color.

svg.title: Concrete
svg.desc: Structural pads and infrastructure; restrained mineral texture. Neutral relief is tinted by the model color.

svg.title: Honed travertine
svg.desc: Long-cut limestone with soft mineral bedding, pores and tightly honed joints. Neutral relief is tinted by the model.

svg.title: Board-formed concrete
svg.desc: Weathered timber shutter marks, recessed tie holes and a fine mineral surface. Neutral relief is tinted by the model.

svg.title: Oiled cedar
svg.desc: Narrow vertical cedar battens with warm grain, knots and recessed seams. Neutral relief is tinted by the model.

svg.title: Pool mosaic
svg.desc: Small glazed ceramic tesserae with alternating tones, pale grout and rippling caustics. Neutral relief is tinted by the model.

svg.title: Garden flagstone
svg.desc: Hand-laid irregular sandstone paving with recessed joints and softly worn edges. Neutral relief is tinted by the model.

svg.title: Decorative glazed tile
svg.desc: Hand-painted blue and ivory ceramic stars for Mediterranean courtyard accents. Neutral relief is tinted by the model.

svg.title: Salt crust
svg.desc: Cracked mineral crust with crystalline seams and fine grains. Neutral relief is tinted by the model.

svg.title: Limewashed plaster
svg.desc: Broad overlapping brush strokes, soft mineral clouds and fine pores. Model paint supplies the color.

svg.title: Herringbone brick
svg.desc: Small alternating fired pavers with narrow mortar, worn faces and a soft beveled edge.

svg.title: Scalloped shingles
svg.desc: Layered rounded shingles for coastal gables, with paired nail heads and fine timber grain.

svg.title: Woven canvas
svg.desc: Restrained warp and weft with stitched seams. A neutral textile for striped market canopies.
